title: 誤文修正｜なぜ不自然かを見抜く
focus: 時制・節・語法・一致
description: 正しい形を暗記するだけでなく、どのルール同士が衝突しているかを見つけて全文を書き直す。

questions.prompt: 誤りを直し、自然な英文を全文書いてください。
questions.sentence: Although he was tired, but he continued working.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: Although he was tired, he continued working.
He was tired, but he continued working.

questions.prompt: 時間表現と時制の衝突を直してください。
questions.sentence: I have visited Kyoto last year.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: I visited Kyoto last year.

questions.prompt: suggest の後ろの形を直してください。
questions.sentence: She suggested me to take a short break.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: She suggested that I take a short break.

questions.prompt: to が前置詞であることに注意して直してください。
questions.sentence: I look forward to meet you again.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: I look forward to meeting you again.

questions.prompt: 主語の中心語を見て一致を直してください。
questions.sentence: Each of the answers have a different problem.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: Each of the answers has a different problem.

questions.prompt: 過去の2出来事の前後関係を直してください。
questions.sentence: By the time we arrived, the movie already started.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: By the time we arrived, the movie had already started.

questions.prompt: 関係詞節の中で目的語を二重にしないよう直してください。
questions.sentence: The book that I bought it yesterday was expensive.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: The book that I bought yesterday was expensive.

questions.prompt: if節の未来表現を直してください。
questions.sentence: If I will have enough time tomorrow, I will finish it.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: If I have enough time tomorrow, I will finish it.

questions.prompt: despite の後ろを名詞相当に直してください。
questions.sentence: Despite he was nervous, he gave a clear presentation.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: Although he was nervous, he gave a clear presentation.
Despite being nervous, he gave a clear presentation.
Despite the fact that he was nervous, he gave a clear presentation.

questions.prompt: 使役 make の後ろの形を直してください。
questions.sentence: The teacher made us to rewrite the paragraph.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: The teacher made us rewrite the paragraph.

questions.prompt: be used to の to は前置詞です。直してください。
questions.sentence: I am used to wake up early now.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: I am used to waking up early now.

questions.prompt: 状態動詞を不要な進行形にしないよう直してください。
questions.sentence: I have been knowing him for ten years.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: I have known him for ten years.

questions.note: know は通常、継続中の状態として have known を使う。

questions.prompt: 前置詞の後ろの代名詞の形を直してください。
questions.sentence: Between you and I, the plan seems risky.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: Between you and me, the plan seems risky.

questions.prompt: explain の目的語の置き方を直してください。
questions.sentence: He explained me the rule twice.

fields.label: 修正文
answers: He explained the rule to me twice.

title: 構造トラップ｜Vっぽい形を全部Vにしない
focus: finite verb・非定形・節の入れ子
description: 分詞・不定詞・倒置・名詞節・同格節など、「動詞の形が見える=主節V」では通用しない文を分解する。

questions.prompt: 分詞句を外し、主節S/Vを書いてください。
questions.sentence: Having finished the report, Maya sent it to her manager before lunch.

fields.label: 主節S
answers: Maya

fields.label: 主節V
answers: sent

questions.prompt: reduced relative clauseを外して主節S/Vを書いてください。
questions.sentence: Anyone interested in joining the project should contact Maya by Friday.

fields.label: 主節S
answers: Anyone

fields.label: 主節V
answers: should contact

questions.prompt: to不定詞はpersonを説明しています。主節S/Vを書いてください。
questions.sentence: The first person to notice the mistake was a new employee.

fields.label: 主節S
answers: The first person

fields.label: 主節V
answers: was

questions.prompt: that節の中にさらにwhat節があります。文全体の主節S/Vを書いてください。
questions.sentence: The idea that what he said might be true frightened everyone.

fields.label: 主節S
answers: The idea

fields.label: 主節V
answers: frightened

questions.prompt: Whether節全体が主語です。S/Vを書いてください。
questions.sentence: Whether we postpone the event depends on the weather tomorrow.

fields.label: S
answers: Whether we postpone the event

fields.label: V
answers: depends

questions.prompt: promiseの後ろに2つの不定詞が並列されています。文全体のfinite Vは？
questions.sentence: She promised to call me and explain what had happened.

questions.prompt: 知覚動詞の後ろの cross の役割として最も近いものは？
questions.sentence: I saw him cross the street.
choices: Oを説明する補語の一部
questions.answer: Oを説明する補語の一部

questions.prompt: 受動態にすると bare infinitive がどう変わる？
questions.sentence: He was seen ___ the street.

questions.prompt: the more構文で、それぞれの節のS/Vを意識して意味の中心を書いてください。
questions.sentence: The more carefully you read the sentence, the easier the structure becomes.

fields.label: 第1節S/V
answers: you / read

fields.label: 第2節S/V
answers: the structure / becomes

questions.prompt: 倒置を通常語順に戻したときの主節S/Vを書いてください。
questions.sentence: Never before had I seen such a confusing sentence.

fields.label: S
answers: I

fields.label: V
answers: had seen

questions.prompt: No sooner ... than の時間関係として正しいのは？
questions.sentence: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
choices: 座る前に電話が鳴った
座るとほぼ同時に電話が鳴った
questions.answer: 座るとほぼ同時に電話が鳴った

questions.prompt: it は形式主語です。本当の内容を示す部分も含めて構造を説明してください。
questions.sentence: It is difficult to tell whether this explanation is complete.

fields.label: 主節V
answers: is

fields.label: C
answers: difficult

fields.label: 内容
answers: to tell whether this explanation is complete

questions.prompt: that節の種類として最も近いものは？
questions.sentence: The fact that the data was incomplete worried the team.
choices: fact の内容を示す同格節
fact を目的語にする節
questions.answer: fact の内容を示す同格節

questions.prompt: 「動詞っぽい形を全部Vにしない」ための自分用チェック手順を、このセットの例を使って3段階で作ってください。
questions.guide: finite verb、節の境界、非定形(to do / -ing / 過去分詞)を分ける手順を作る。
